copy.headline: All CMA Awards New Artist of the Year Winners Over 30: Stephen Wilson Jr., Jelly Roll & More
copy.caption: The CMA has presented new artist of the year (formerly known as the Horizon Award) 46 times. As the years have gone by, the winners have gotten appreciably older.
